policy.restore_collector_from_site_or_reenable_: site has post-processed fields that collector would delete on wholesale sync
policy.site_update_candidate_after_review: collector has new fields absent from site; review before copying
policy.individual_review: mixed direction or human-authored/detail/date fields; review event-by-event
policy.collector_only_postprocess_rule: collector has an internal postprocessor rule that is excluded from the public snapshot
policy.rule_prediction_replaces_matching_histor: collector rule prediction keeps the same displayed date as the legacy historical slide
policy.fixed_date_rule_basis_refresh: collector fixed-date postprocessor keeps the same displayed date while refreshing the public basis text
